classification.difficultyReason: Complete the scaffolded sum table and interpret compound and inequality conditions to select favourable cells from 16 equally likely ordered outcomes.

content.prompt: The total sum is recorded from rolling two four-sided dice.

inlines.text: Each cell is the sum of the two die results; all 16 outcomes are equally likely.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the probability that the outcome is:

answer.worked:
There are $4\times4=16$ equally likely outcomes. Only $(1,1)$ has sum 2.
$$P(2)=\frac{1}{16}$$

Sum 2 occurs once and sum 3 occurs twice.
$$\begin{aligned}P(2\text{ or }3)&=\frac{1+2}{16}\\&=\frac{3}{16}\end{aligned}$$

Sums 2, 3 and 4 occur 1, 2 and 3 times respectively.
$$\begin{aligned}P(\text{sum}\leq4)&=\frac{1+2+3}{16}\\&=\frac{6}{16}\\&=\frac{3}{8}\end{aligned}$$

Sum 7 occurs twice and sum 8 occurs once.
$$\begin{aligned}P(\text{sum}>6)&=\frac{2+1}{16}\\&=\frac{3}{16}\end{aligned}$$
